change: Rename Attrition Rate to Leaver Share, keeping the expression.
tmdl_after:
measure 'Leaver Share' = DIVIDE([Leaver Count], [Headcount])
		description: leavers divided by headcount after rename. Report to at least a tenth of a percentage point.

labels_after.what: leavers divided by headcount after rename
labels_after.rule_in_words: Show the fractional value as a percent with one or two decimal places, not as an unscaled decimal or rounded whole percent.
labels_after.why: The current expression and metadata establish the unit and precision; the earlier suggestion is stale.

change: Replace profit divided by revenue with operating profit dollars.

		description: operating profit dollars after expression edit. Cents must remain visible.

labels_after.rule_in_words: Show a dollar amount with exactly two decimal places; grouping and negative parentheses are allowed, but percent or scaling is not.
